fields.default: The sail loft with the sloping floor

fields.name: body
fields.label: Text
fields.default:
By the spring of 2014 the garage in Leith was too small for a dining table, let alone the people building it. Rosa found the sail loft on Canal Street through a customer who had bought a stool. The roof leaked in two places and the floor dropped four centimetres from the door to the window.

We took it anyway. The slope turned out to be useful: sawdust drifts towards the door, and every bench we have built since has one leg longer than the others.

Eleven years later the loft holds six makers, two apprentices and a workshop dog called Dovetail. Aldous and Finch still builds about forty pieces a year, each one signed underneath by the person who made it.
